

{{infobox Chinese|l=Yin Fire Snake|kanji=丁巳|romaji=hinoto mi|onyomi=teishi|p=dīsì|w=ting-ssu|mi=tʰiŋ⁵³ sɨ|y=deng1 si6|j=deng1 si6|ci=tɛŋ siː|mc=tæŋ si|oc-bs=tæŋ si}}
{{Sexagenary cycle}}

'''Yin Fire Snake''' (丁巳, ''hinoto mi''; onyomi ''teishi'') is the 54th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|en|Sexagenary cycle|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 54th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yang Fire Dragon|ja|丙辰}} and followed by {{ill|Yang Earth Horse|ja|戊午}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} ''丁'' is Yin Fire, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch}} ''巳'' (Snake) is Yin Fire; together they form a Biwa (Mutual Harmony) relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing}}.

==Pronunciation==
* English: Yin Fire Snake (丁巳)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): dīngsì
** Cantonese (Jyutping): ding1 si6
** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: hinoto-mi
*** On'yomi: teishi
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): jeongsa (정사)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Đinh Tỵ

==Months of Yin Fire Snake==
In a {{ill|Common Era|en|Common Era|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era}} year whose final digit is 3 or 8 (when the {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stems}} are {{ill|Mizunoto (癸)|ja|癸|lt=Mizunoto (癸)|2=ja|3=癸|4=zh|5=癸|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui}} or {{ill|Tsuchinoe (戊)|ja|戊|lt=Tsuchinoe (戊)|2=ja|3=戊|4=zh|5=戊|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bo}}), the month of {{ill|April|en|April|qid=Q118|lt=April}} is designated as the {{ill|Month|en|Month|qid=Q5151|lt=month (calendar)}} of {{ill|Yin Fire Snake|ja|丁巳|2=ja|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Teishi|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}. However, here the term "month" may refer either to the month of the {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦|11=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Lunisolar}} or to the {{ill|Solar term|en|Solar term|qid=Q1190993|lt=Solar term}} (from {{ill|Lixia|en|Lixia|qid=Q1191007|lt=Lixia}} until the day before {{ill|Mangzhong|en|Mangzhong|qid=Q1147880|lt=Mangzhong}}) as applicable.

==Days of Yin Fire Snake==
=== 選日 ===
The selected day for {{ill|Yin Fire Snake|ja|丁巳|2=ja|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Teishi|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} is the 4th day of {{ill|Hassen|ja|八専|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hassen}} (excluding gap days).
